oldRouteWithdrawn.basis: The normalized target (cp-000122, registry row 122, canonical_name 'Gezondheidswetenschappen', display_name_en 'Health Sciences', production_order 121, source_provider_id 113A920, programme_unit_code 1001O5913, recognized_programme_code 56553, languages_json=["NLD"], modes_json=["VOLTIJD"]) names no specific route. The current formally adopted Onderwijs- en Examenregeling (OER) for academic year 2025-2026 (s7, decided 17 June 2025, in force from 1 September 2025; Bijlage 3) confirms that after a shared 60-EC first year the major requires choosing one of five co-equal richtingen from year 2: Biologie en Gezondheid (biological mechanisms of health), Beleid, Management en Evaluatie van Zorg (policy, management and evaluation of care organisations), Digitale Technologie en Zorg (digital health technology), Geestelijke Gezondheidszorg (clinical psychopathology and mental-health care), and Preventie en Gezondheid (population-level disease prevention, health promotion, health protection and public health policy). Applying the Section 2.1 neutral route-selection hierarchy: Biologie en Gezondheid, Digitale Technologie en Zorg and Geestelijke Gezondheidszorg each commit to one narrow disciplinary, technical or clinical specialism (respectively human biology, digital-health engineering, and clinical psychopathology/diagnostics), and Beleid, Management en Evaluatie van Zorg is centred specifically on the administration and evaluation of care organisations. Preventie en Gezondheid instead studies population health through an integrated combination of biological, behavioural and environmental determinants (Uitdagingen in de Public Health; Disease and Prevention), health promotion and protection (Planmatige Gezondheidsbevordering; Gezondheidsbescherming) and health policy in a comparative/international frame (Public Health Policy; Public Health in International Context) -- the broadest, least specialised of the five richtingen and the one that most directly continues the shared first-year introduction to 'een leven lang gezond', 'bedreigingen van gezondheid' and 'zorg(en) voor gezondheid' without narrowing to one professional technique, organisation type or clinical population. The current official overview and specialisaties pages (s3, s4, checked 2026-09-27) independently describe the programme's own general identity as an integrated study of the biological, behavioural and environmental/social determinants of health, consistent with Preventie en Gezondheid's own scope rather than with any of the other four richtingen's narrower professional focus. Preventie en Gezondheid is therefore selected as the reconstructed route under Section 2.1's 'least specialised or most general route' branch of the hierarchy.
